assessment.reason: Query 1x amplitudes 0.00068-0.00168 across ch0-3 match normal reference trials (0.0004-0.0015) and are ~5-10x below unbalance (0.004-0.015) and looseness (0.004-0.013) references. 2x pattern 0.0029-0.0031 on ch0/ch2 with low 0.0005-0.0006 on ch1/ch3 matches normal (ch0/2 ~0.0025-0.0054, ch1/3 <0.001) and is well below misalignment references which show elevated 2x on ch0/ch2 0.0047-0.0154. 3x low, rms 0.032-0.038, kurtosis ~3.2-3.4 and crest ~4.5-7.3 consistent with normal. Limitation: radial-only short record cannot fully exclude early looseness/misalignment, but no fault signature present vs labelled trials.
